full_judgment: 3. The relevant facts, in short, are that the schedule land was a part of former resurvey settlement plot No. 790 and the entire land of said plot was being possessed and enjoyed openly, uninterruptedly and continuously, since time immemorial, by villagers of Angarjure, which originally belonged to Zeminder Sim Raja of Cherapunji, and the suit land was taken in the Patton by Kutu Mia and 10 others, on behalf of the residence of Angarjure, which was registered on 25th Falgun, 1322 B.S. and that when villagers of Angarjure were thus owning and possessing the same survey Plot No. 790 was divided into two fragments and recorded as S.S. Plot No. 1529 in the name of the Government and S.S. Plot No.1546 in the name of Umed Ali and 10 others, representing the villagers of Angarjure..Subsequently one Abdul Whab took settlement of said S.S. Plot No. 1529 from the Government and thus the enjoyment of the said plot by the villagers was disturbed. Accordingly the villagers instituted Title Suit No.122 of 1961 through one Abdul Gafur Chowdhury and others in the Court of Sadar Munsif, which, on transfer, was renumbered as Title Suit No. 29 of 1963 and was heard and disposed of by the Munsif, Additional Court, who dismissed the suit by the judgment and decree dated 24.6.63 and the Title Appeal No.403 of 1963 filed there-against was also dismissed. In the year 1368 B.S. Abdul Gafur Chowdhury and others got permanent lease of the said plot on behalf of villagers of the Angarjure and the said Angarju villagers consisting of three parts, commonly, known as Paras, namely Purbapara also known as Porbatpura/ Porbatpur, (ii) Majeirpara or Agpoud and (iii) Pashchim Para or. Kuwor Poud. The plaintiff in the first part of 1979 came to know that some interested persons of Purbapara got change in the names and address of the recorded tenants in the Khatian in order to show that the suit land belong to the inhabitants of Purbapara or Porbatpur, 'against which villagers of Angarjure filed objection to the Revenue Officer, who advised them to move the Civil Court and he also submitted a report to the local S.D.O. on 21/6/79 and that claiming such wrong entry in the Khatian the interested persons claimed Porbatpur as a separate village.
